boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase activities at Detroit Mercy and in Detroit, with eligibility and access details noted.

cards.entity_name: Michael & Gail Whitty Student Fitness Center
cards.title: Work out at Whitty
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Activate your Titan ID and complete the recreation waiver, then meet up for a workout using the center’s included equipment.
cards.short_summary: A student fitness-center workout with a free current-student membership.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy states that membership to the Michael & Gail Whitty Student Fitness Center is free for current students and employees.
cards.source_title: Get Started | University of Detroit Mercy Recreation
cards.access_notes: Current Detroit Mercy students and employees: activate Titan ID and complete the recreation waiver before entry.

cards.title: Take a free fitness class
cards.subtitle: Whitty Student Fitness Center, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Use your Detroit Mercy email to register through IMLeagues, then bring a friend to a scheduled fitness class.
cards.short_summary: Group exercise classes included for Detroit Mercy fitness-center members.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Recreation lists free fitness classes among the benefits of free student and employee fitness-center membership.
cards.source_title: Get Started | University of Detroit Mercy Recreation
cards.access_notes: For current Detroit Mercy students and employees; register through IMLeagues using a Detroit Mercy email.

cards.title: Join an intramural game
cards.subtitle: University Recreation, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Create an IMLeagues account with your Detroit Mercy email, form a group or join an available intramural activity.
cards.short_summary: Campus intramural recreation with no participation fee for the Detroit Mercy community.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Recreation identifies intramural sports as free, and its waiver states intramural participation is free to Detroit Mercy students and employees.
cards.source_title: University Recreation | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Detroit Mercy students and employees can sign up through IMLeagues with a Detroit Mercy email.

cards.title: Pause in Holy Spirit Chapel
cards.subtitle: Student Union, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Head to the ground floor of the Student Union for a quiet, small-group moment of prayer or reflection between classes.
cards.short_summary: An ecumenical campus chapel designated for student prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy says Holy Spirit Ecumenical Chapel is on the Student Union ground floor and is open to all students for prayer and reflection.
cards.source_title: Worship Spaces, Schedules and Sacramental Prep | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Open to all Detroit Mercy students for prayer and reflection; it is at the end of the Student Union study-room hall.

cards.title: Reflect at the library
cards.subtitle: McNichols Campus Library
cards.notes: Use the ground-floor reflection room for a calm check-in with friends, quiet reflection, or individual prayer.
cards.short_summary: A student reflection room in the McNichols Campus Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy describes the Multi-Faith Reflection Room as open to all students for prayer and reflection.
cards.source_title: Worship Spaces, Schedules and Sacramental Prep | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; located on the ground floor of the McNichols Campus Library.

cards.title: Visit St. Ignatius Chapel
cards.subtitle: Commerce & Finance Building, McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Meet quietly in the chapel for reflection, or attend a scheduled service; people of all faiths are welcome.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel for reflection and scheduled worship services.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy identifies St. Ignatius Chapel as a McNichols Campus spiritual resource and says people of all faiths are welcome to the chapel and services.
cards.source_title: Worship Spaces, Schedules and Sacramental Prep | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Located in the Commerce & Finance Building; consult the university page for current service times.

cards.title: Get a Detroit Public Library card
cards.subtitle: Main Library, Midtown Detroit
cards.notes: Bring a valid student ID or enrollment proof to any DPL location, then use your card to borrow materials from the system.
cards.short_summary: Detroit students, including university students, can obtain a free DPL card.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Public Library states that students attending a university located in Detroit can get a free library card, even if they do not live in the city.
cards.access_notes: Detroit Mercy is located in Detroit; adult students should bring a valid student ID or proof of current enrollment.

cards.title: Use free library Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: Main Library, Midtown Detroit
cards.notes: Bring a device and settle into the Main Library for a shared study session; connect directly to the library’s wireless signal.
cards.short_summary: A no-card-needed way to get online at Detroit Public Library locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Public Library states that most locations offer free wireless internet and that users do not need a library card or password to connect.
cards.source_title: Using a Computer at the Detroit Public Library | Detroit Public Library
cards.access_notes: Most DPL locations offer the service; no library card or password is required for wireless access.

cards.title: See the DIA galleries
cards.subtitle: 5200 Woodward Avenue, Detroit
cards.notes: If you live in Wayne County, bring ID to the front desk and explore the general-admission galleries with a friend.
cards.short_summary: General admission is free for Wayne County residents, including eligible Detroit-area students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Detroit Institute of Arts states that general admission is always free for Wayne County residents who present ID at the front desk.
cards.source_title: General Admission Tickets | Detroit Institute of Arts
cards.access_notes: Free only for residents of Wayne, Oakland, or Macomb counties and DIA members; present ID. Ticketed exhibitions may differ.

cards.title: Ride the Cullen Family Carousel
cards.subtitle: Cullen Plaza, Detroit Riverfront
cards.notes: Check the seasonal opening window, then take a free carousel ride featuring Detroit River creatures before walking the riverfront.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal, free carousel at Cullen Plaza on the Detroit Riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Riverfront Conservancy lists the Cullen Family Carousel at Cullen Plaza as free during its stated seasonal operating period.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal: the Conservancy lists it as open Tuesday–Sunday, noon–7 p.m., from May 22 through Labor Day; verify before traveling.
